source_conclusions: The copied app entry alone changes to the diagnostic view; no production Compose/Koin/game entry executes. The driver declares only Swift entry, XCTest and Xcode project modifications plus four copied additions, keeps production filesystem/Keychain byte-identical and checks the complete copied-input inventory before/after workers stop.

The Kotlin hook calls the concrete IosSnapshotFileSystem with default real Keychain/crypto and default dispatcher. The only wrapper surrounds real excludeSnapshotFromBackup with before/after metadata observations. Two authenticated write/read round trips use fixed public bytes, not GameSnapshot fixtures or key seams.

Six ordered samples identify the new directory and installed first/overwritten file before/after real backup exclusion. Kotlin/native identity agreement and the shared sampler FD closure are required before returning to the writer. No old observer FD survives atomic replacement and no inode-change assumption is enforced.

Each sample and final receipt is bounded, metadata-only and written exclusively in owned app tmp rather than the ciphertext directory. Partial/failure rows are preserved; no raw key, plaintext/ciphertext payload, protection xattr or NSError description is emitted.

The host reader is separately built arm64 macOS code, restricted by compiled device/token plus driver-supplied canonical final container/inodes. It performs no setters or payload reads, checks final app inode identity, and cannot substitute its different Foundation/process/platform observations for iOS evidence.

The existing normal lane remains pinned and owns source binding, copy, isolated build, task workers and journaled simulator finalization. Only one XCTest is selected; normal launch repetitions, libproc observation and notice qualification are not invoked. Their status fields stay NOT_RUN.

Diagnostic CAPTURED_NOT_PROTECTION_PASS is not strict PASS. Six new strict comparisons are independent of A37 0/26, and no snapshot-validation, retained-host, normal Debug, dependency, combined, hardware or Store gate is waived.
